nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: The bench faces the lanes; one foot rests just outside the paint. How do you want to think about it?

choices.text: Check whether there is room to rest.

nodes.speaker: pattern
nodes.text: The paint curves around the foot. Perhaps the bench was already here when the lane was repainted. That is only a guess.

effects.speaker: pattern
effects.text: The paint curves around the foot. Perhaps the bench was already here when the lane was repainted. That is only a guess.

nodes.speaker: pattern
nodes.text: Four stripes, four seats, you decide. Then you count the bench slats again. Perhaps your pattern was in too much of a hurry.

effects.speaker: pattern
effects.text: Four stripes, four seats, you decide. Then you count the bench slats again. Perhaps your pattern was in too much of a hurry.

nodes.speaker: guard
nodes.text: The fastenings look intact from here. There is space to sit without having to make a decision about anything else.

effects.speaker: guard
effects.text: The fastenings look intact from here. There is space to sit without having to make a decision about anything else.

nodes.speaker: guard
nodes.text: That shadow could be a loose fastening. Or it could just be a shadow; leave a little room and look again later.

effects.speaker: guard
effects.text: That shadow could be a loose fastening. Or it could just be a shadow; leave a little room and look again later.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: The bench can stay a bench for now.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: The notice is faded. Its letters have a different rhythm near the bottom. Which thought do you want to follow?

choices.text: Look for a reason to be careful.

nodes.speaker: resonance
nodes.text: One stroke stops and starts again. It suggests a change of hand, or just an interrupted writer. You cannot remember which.

effects.speaker: resonance
effects.text: One stroke stops and starts again. It suggests a change of hand, or just an interrupted writer. You cannot remember which.

nodes.speaker: resonance
nodes.text: For a moment it feels like your handwriting. The feeling is vivid, but it does not tell you who wrote it.

effects.speaker: resonance
effects.text: For a moment it feels like your handwriting. The feeling is vivid, but it does not tell you who wrote it.

nodes.speaker: guard
nodes.text: The folded corner leaves the times visible. Someone may have wanted the next reader to find them without unfolding it.

effects.speaker: guard
effects.text: The folded corner leaves the times visible. Someone may have wanted the next reader to find them without unfolding it.

nodes.speaker: guard
nodes.text: You imagine a warning under the fold. The back may be blank. There is no need to invent an emergency.

effects.speaker: guard
effects.text: You imagine a warning under the fold. The back may be blank. There is no need to invent an emergency.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: The notice is still there when you look away.

nodes.speaker: pattern
nodes.text: the lines nearly meet, but a nearly is not a map. Keep the small difference.

effects.speaker: pattern
effects.text: the lines nearly meet, but a nearly is not a map. Keep the small difference.

nodes.speaker: pattern
nodes.text: two lines must lead to the same place. Then the paint runs out, and the conclusion is still yours alone.

effects.speaker: pattern
effects.text: two lines must lead to the same place. Then the paint runs out, and the conclusion is still yours alone.

nodes.speaker: resonance
nodes.text: the ring makes you think of a game someone paused. That is an association, not a memory.

effects.speaker: resonance
effects.text: the ring makes you think of a game someone paused. That is an association, not a memory.

nodes.speaker: resonance
nodes.text: you can almost hear a whistle here. It might be memory, or only the wind moving the metal.

effects.speaker: resonance
effects.text: you can almost hear a whistle here. It might be memory, or only the wind moving the metal.
